gen-dafont-groovy-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi is a sans with a wide-eyed e and oversized lowercase. Groovy's nearly shut c and constant-width strokes sit against Yaldevi's open e, and that closed-versus-open tension is the hook.
gen-dafont-horizon-fs-karma: A tube-like stroke, like neon glass, gives Horizon its nearly closed rounds and tall, generous lowercase up top. Horizon grabs attention; Karma, a text serif, keeps eyes moving with gentle modulation.
gen-dafont-horizon-fs-paquito: Paquito is a confident serif whose caps barely rise above its lowercase. Horizon's neon-tube strokes hold their width from stem to curve and make the statement, while Paquito is happiest carrying a couple of lines beneath.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-abeezee: Every Impact Label letter stands alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding. ABeeZee, an approachable sans with a high mean line, follows underneath and lightens the mood.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-aldrich: Impact Label puts each heavy letter on its own little island. That commanding weight does the shouting, while Aldrich, a sans-serif drawn with one pen tip, does the quiet tracing.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-amiko: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label leaves a gap around every letter, like beads on a rod. And Amiko, with crayon-tall lowercase and outward-pointing terminals, carries paragraphs along without effort.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla brings wide, barely curled s curves and a short reach from midline to ascender beneath Impact Label's heavy letters. Contemporary and approachable, it softens every blow the heading lands.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-devanaga: Impact Label sets each heavy letter apart like a bead on a rod, all commanding weight. But Anek Devanagari, a sans-serif with distinctly open mouths, does the patient work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-gujarati: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label keeps each letter alone, like a bead on a rod. Anek Gujarati handles the reading, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its c gaping.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Big, blunt, beads on a rod: Impact Label sets each heavy letter apart, with a high-set x-height guide. Anek Gurmukhi's big open counters give that weight room to breathe.
